title: Integrated Novelty Detection Systems: From Sensor Networks to Multi-Novelty Computer Vision
abstract: arXiv:2610.19347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Novelty detection is crucial in various technological and scientific domains. Its importance spans from ensuring the reliability of sensor networks to enhancing the adaptability of computer vision systems. As AI systems become increasingly sophisticated and complex, effective anomaly detection is essential for maintaining reliability and accuracy. This work addresses novelty detection in weather sensor networks and computer vision. In weather sensor networks, particularly for monitoring rainfall, detecting blocked rain gauges can significantly impact data reliability, food security, and disaster management. This work evaluates four existing quality control methods for detecting blocked rain gauges and demonstrates their limitations, particularly in detecting clusters of faulty sensors. By comparing methods such as the Conditional Mixture Model (CMM), PSWQ (Fz-filter), Kernel Regression, and Gaussian Method, we identify their shortcomings

translated_title: 集成新颖性检测系统：从传感器网络到多新颖性计算机视觉
translated_abstract: 新颖性检测在众多技术和科学领域中都至关重要，其重要性涵盖从确保传感器网络的可靠性到增强计算机视觉系统的适应性。随着人工智能系统日益精密和复杂，有效的异常检测对于维持系统的可靠性和准确性变得不可或缺。本工作研究了气象传感器网络和计算机视觉中的新颖性检测问题。在气象传感器网络中，特别是在降雨监测方面，检测被堵塞的雨量计会显著影响数据可靠性、粮食安全和灾害管理。本工作评估了四种现有的用于检测堵塞雨量计的质量控制方法，并展示了它们的局限性，尤其是在检测成片故障传感器集群方面的不足。通过比较条件混合模型（CMM）、PSWQ（Fz-filter）、核回归和高斯方法，我们识别出了这些方法的缺陷。
tldr: 本文针对气象传感器网络中的雨量计堵塞检测问题，评估并揭示了四种现有质量控制方法的局限性，特别是它们在检测成片故障传感器集群时的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates four existing quality control methods for detecting blocked rain gauges in weather sensor networks and demonstrates their limitations, particularly in detecting clusters of faulty sensors.
